_comment: Per-starter XP learnset, paced for the FULL 8-gym + Elite 4 arc (not just the 1-gym PoC). starter_deck = the 3-card Normal-filler deck you begin with. Each entry in `lines` is one move 'line' whose stages unlock at cumulative XP: the first stage is ADDED to the deck, later stages REPLACE the previous card in that line (Vine Whip -> Razor Leaf -> Leaf Storm). A stage with xp 0 is granted at run start.
_economy: XP economy (see constants.json xp): per_wild=10, per_mid_boss=30, per_gym_boss=90. Unlock ladder (cumulative XP): [30, 100, 190, 280, 370, 460, 550, 640, 700]. Whole-arc pacing: full move set by ~gym 8 (minimum path) / ~gym 6 (every optional wild cleared), ~1-2 unlocks per gym. Values PROVISIONAL, to be tuned once the 8-gym run_config exists (Phase 5).
_gym1_target: Gym 1 (Brock) is reached after 2 mid-bosses + ~10 optional wilds. XP available BEFORE the leader: 60 on the skip path (2 x 30) rising to ~160 with a full wild grind (60 + 10 x 10). Ladder is tuned so move #1 (rung1=30) is guaranteed pre-Brock, and move #2 (rung2=100) is a GRIND REWARD: unreachable on the pure skip path (60 < 100) but attainable with ~4 wilds, giving grinders their second move before the gym leader to make the fight easier. rung3=190 sits above the ~160 grind ceiling, so a full pre-Brock grind yields exactly the 2nd move.
